observations: Two photos show a dirty, used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly sitting on bare ground, surrounded by loose bolts and unrelated engine parts.
No casing stamp, part-number plate, or VIN/fitment sticker is legible in either photo.
A watermark reads 'VINCO AUTO SPARE PARTS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', indicating a marketplace listing image, not proof of the part's origin.
No pin-count connector is clearly visible or countable to confirm the claimed '22pin' designation.
No video or photo shows the unit running, shifting, or being bench-tested.
A sandal is visible in photo 1, confirming an informal, open-air parts yard setting rather than a verified shop.

identity.kind: used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly (claimed Lexus ES350 fitment)

claims.evidence: No stamp, tag, or pin connector legible in photo 0 or photo 1 to confirm make, model, year range, or pin count.
No receipt, shop signage, or written warranty document shown in either photo.
No functional test, video, or bench-run shown; condition cannot be judged from static photos.
No import sticker, auction tag, or shipping label visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Gearbox may not actually be a genuine Lexus ES350 unit or may not match the claimed 2012/2014 22-pin specification.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the casing ID/part-number stamp and the wiring harness connector showing pin count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unconfirmed-fitment used transmission, not as a confirmed Lexus ES350 unit

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (clutch packs, solenoids, torque converter, mechatronic unit) cannot be assessed from exterior photos.
risks.proof: Video of the unit being turned/tested on a bench or installed and shifting through gears.

risks.risk: Hidden fluid leaks or seal damage not visible under the grime.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seals, output shafts, and pan gasket after cleaning.

risks.risk: Six-month guarantee may be unenforceable or informal (no paperwork, no fixed shop address).
risks.proof: Photo of a written warranty card/receipt with shop name, address, and contact.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no guarantee exists

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history of the donor vehicle is unknown, affecting expected remaining life.
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle's odometer or an auction sheet showing mileage.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the gearbox casing stamp or part-number plate.
Close-up photo of the wiring connector showing actual pin count.
Video of the gearbox being tested (bench spin or installed, shifting through gears).
Photo of any import/auction sticker confirming Japan origin.
Photo or scan of the written warranty/guarantee document.
response.reason: The claimed model/fitment (Lexus ES350, 22-pin, 2012/2014) is the detail that sets the price for a transmission, but no stamp, tag, or connector is legible in either photo to confirm it, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to the right comparable without that shot.
